title: Unisex Alien – Visiting. Not Impressed. Embroidered Zip Hoodie

seo.title: Alien Zip Up Hoodie – Visiting. Not Impressed.
seo.description: An alien zip up hoodie: VISITING. NOT IMPRESSED. on the back over an unimpressed alien and its saucer, plus an embroidered flying saucer on the chest.

descriptionHtml:
The Story

This alien zip up hoodie is for the person who has seen the planet and is not impressed, zipped on for a desert road trip, a convention and the walk home from a very long meeting.

A grumpy teal alien with arms crossed leans on a flying saucer parked beside a desert shack and a cactus under a crescent moon, in teal, coral and cream with a worn print texture. VISITING. runs above it and NOT IMPRESSED. below in tall condensed capitals, the second line a touch wider than the first: gold and cream on Black and Navy, ochre and navy on Ash. The full print is on the back. On the front, a small flying saucer with legs and a row of lights is embroidered on the left chest, and the word MEH is stitched on the left cuff, in white thread on Black and Navy and navy thread on Ash. Original art, made for Graphic Tees Co. and printed and stitched the day you order it.

Details & Fit

  • Regular fit zip-up hoodie with a metal zipper
  • 50% cotton, 50% polyester fleece, soft inside and outside
  • Fabric weight: 8 oz/yd²
  • Embroidered left-chest flying saucer and left-cuff MEH, printed back
  • Front pouch pockets and an unlined hood with color-matched drawcord
  • Double-needle stitching at shoulders, armholes, neck, waistband and cuffs
  • Sizes S–3XL
  • 3 colors: Black, Navy and Ash
  • Blank product sourced from Honduras and El Salvador

Questions

How does the Visiting. Not Impressed. zip hoodie fit?
The Visiting. Not Impressed. alien zip up hoodie from Graphic Tees Co. is a regular unisex fit in sizes S through 3XL. Order your usual size for an easy layer over a tee, or go up one for a roomier fit. The first size exchange within 30 days is free.

Is this alien hoodie warm enough for cold desert nights?
It is a mid-weight layer. The Graphic Tees Co. zip hoodie is a Gildan 18600 in 8 oz fleece, 50% cotton and 50% polyester, soft inside and outside, with a metal zipper, front pouch pockets and an unlined hood. It handles cold desert nights, windy road trips and long waits at the airport well.

Where are the print and the embroidery on this zip hoodie?
The full design, VISITING. above the art and NOT IMPRESSED. below, is printed across the back so the zipper never splits it. On the front, a small flying saucer with legs and a row of lights sits on the left chest with no words, and MEH is stitched on the left cuff.

How do I care for the embroidery on this hoodie?
Zip the Graphic Tees Co. hoodie, turn it inside out and wash cold with similar colors, then tumble dry on low or hang dry. Skip bleach and do not iron over the stitching. The flying saucer on the chest and the MEH cuff are stitched thread, which keeps its shape wash after wash with gentle care.

Is it a good gift for a sci-fi fan, and when should I order for Christmas?
Yes, for the friend who rolls their eyes at every first contact scene. Graphic Tees Co. makes each embroidered hoodie to order, so for Christmas order by about December 8. Orders over $45 ship free in the US, and one free size exchange within 30 days covers a wrong guess on size.
